name: GPU-based Conservative Voxelization
definition: A two-pass GPU algorithm that converts 3D triangle meshes into a list of voxels using conservative rasterization, followed by an octree construction step. It uses atomic counters to determine voxel count for buffer allocation.
summary: GPU-based Conservative Voxelization is a two-pass GPU algorithm that converts 3D triangle meshes into voxels using conservative rasterization to guarantee no missing voxels for intersected cells.
